arStrings.szText: "Why are there scales carved into the mountain?"
The first Oracle was swallowed by a great serpent, so the legends say. In its belly, she glimpsed a thousand futures, a thousand prophecies. She learned the language of omens.
Recounting the mythology of her Oracle order.
And so from that day forward, all Oracles would dwell in the belly of the serpent.
Recounting the mythology of her Oracle order.
